purpose: OWNER 2026-11-09: a link to any project on any house-plan site must yield a 3D model from its images and data. A first, small measurement of the whole path (acquire -> classify -> read -> solve -> compile) on publishers the analyzer was never developed against.
selection: one project per publisher: the first individual project link found in the markup of the publisher's public listing page on 2026-11-09 (the second where the first was a guide page). Chosen before any run; no page was opened or judged first. Publishers whose listing did not expose project links in static markup, or which refused the client (HTTP 403), are listed as not sampled.
disclosure: After the baseline run these pages are known (DEV, non-blind). They are not a statistical sample. The six ARCHON projects that reach no model in the 33-project corpus are counted beside them.

notSampled.why: no individual project link in the static markup of the listing page fetched; not pursued in this first measurement
